title: ever LAYLAH|Pleated A-Line Chiffon Formal Evening Dress with Short Sleeves and Sequin Waist
descriptionHtml:
This elegant evening dress is crafted from chiffon, featuring short sleeves and a ruched A-line silhouette. The sequin waist embellishments add a touch of luxury, making it perfect for special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
